evals.name: dedupe identity is stable across repeat harvest
expectations: seed(3) + econ rows carrying the same two fills → exactly 3 entries

evals.name: seeds never double-counted against longer book-row text
expectations: seed text is a prefix of the book-row text — identity must still match

evals.name: venture-desk exits 0 with unreachable canon (fail-soft)
expectations: exit code 0 even when DEFU_DIR is bogus
board still written, honest nulls where the oracle is unreachable

evals.name: harness-audit exits 0 with missing canon and keeps counts honest
expectations: exit code 0 even when DEFU_DIR is bogus
missing canon = honest FAILs, never a crash, never green-washed

evals.name: concat-family regression: manabar coerced before arithmetic
expectations: string+number concatenates ("74488519347811969") — the Z-33 third-incident family
canonical num() coercion keeps the sum under the cap

evals.name: stamp hygiene: unstamped books flagged, never fresh
expectations: every book with exists=true and ageHours==null must NOT carry fresh=true
the audit surfaces a timestamp-hygiene check (WARN until owners stamp)
